# cerbos-synapse-envoy-starlark

<!-- Generated by evals/synapse/generate.py; edit the sources there. -->

A smoke test for the `cerbos-synapse-extension` skill: write a Starlark
Envoy ext_authz extension, wire it into Synapse 0.10.2 and prove it with a Synapse
test suite. The [instruction](instruction.md) gives the full request. Every task in the
matrix shares one seeded policy, principal directory and verifier; see
[`evals/synapse`](../../synapse/generate.py) for the sources.

## Environment

The image runs the native `synapse` binary on Python 3.12 (Debian Trixie) with the
Starlark toolchain; pinned versions are in `environment/Dockerfile`.
Synapse is licensed, so the repository never names its distribution repository.
Before the first run, log in to the repository issued with your licence and tag the
image locally; one run covers every Synapse task:

```bash
export CERBOS_DISTRIBUTION_REPO=<repository URL issued with your licence>
docker login "$CERBOS_DISTRIBUTION_REPO"
evals/tasks/cerbos-synapse-envoy-starlark/prepare-image.sh
```

## Verification

| Stage | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `files` | `config.yaml`, extension source and a `*_test.star` suite exist; the config loads an existing `.star` envoy extension; the seeded policy is unchanged. |
| `server_starts` | `synapse server` starts from the agent's `config.yaml` and `/_cerbos/ready` returns 200. |
| `generated_tests` | `synapse test` passes every suite under `/workspace/extensions`, with at least two passing cases. |
| `decisions` | Seven Envoy checks, sent through a verifier-owned `synapse test` suite that loads the agent's config (ext_authz is gRPC), return code 0 or code 7 with an HTTP 403 denied response for the same cases as the route task. |

Every stage must pass for reward 1. Evidence is kept in `/logs/verifier`: one log per
stage, the server log, and the requests and results of the decision stage.

## Running

From the repository root, with Docker running and `prepare-image.sh` run once:

```bash
uvx --from harbor==0.23.0 harbor run --jobs-dir evals/jobs -p evals/tasks/cerbos-synapse-envoy-starlark -a oracle
uvx --from harbor==0.23.0 harbor run --jobs-dir evals/jobs -p evals/tasks/cerbos-synapse-envoy-starlark -a nop
uvx --from harbor==0.23.0 harbor run --jobs-dir evals/jobs -p evals/tasks/cerbos-synapse-envoy-starlark \
  --skill ./cerbos/cerbos-synapse-extension -a codex -m openai/gpt-5.6-luna --agent-kwarg version=0.154.0
```

Oracle scores 1 and nop scores 0.
